findings.detail: Stable nodes, bounded membership, and differentiated relations remain useful.
Moving particles from experiment 001 would misleadingly imply substance transfer. Omitted in 002.
Internal pattern/texture changed within forms rather than receiving transported units.
The central source remains fixed; no decrease in energy or size depicted.
Narrative captions could mask ambiguity; no independent readers were tested.
Color and textures are not claimed as Bailey's esoteric color or ray correspondences.

risks: Seven branching paths can still suggest material emanation despite omitting particles.
Sequential reveal can suggest rays came into being one after another.
Numbered colored channels may look like canonical esoteric color associations.
Three illustrative forms may invite a one-to-one ray/person reading.
Aesthetic coherence does not imply intuitive notation or semantic correctness.
decisions: Do not promote ray textures as seven universal primitives.
Keep source/grammar/style separated in manifest and documentation.
Compare captionless and static baseline before adopting new grammar rules.
Proceed to an atemporal grounding stress-test after reviewing these results.
